title: The Resistance on D'Qar
description: The Resistance movement, led by General Leia Organa, was based on planet D'Qar. Han Solo arrived there with Finn after the battle of Takodana, and the young First Order defector was thrilled to discover that his life-saving friend, pilot Poe Dameron, had survived their crash on Jakku. Now it was up to them and their Resistance allies to locate Rey before Kylo Ren did...although resourceful, Force-sensitive Rey was already managing her own escape.
